show.title: Breaking Bad
show.synopsis: A mild-mannered high school chemistry teacher diagnosed with terminal lung cancer partners with his former student to manufacture and sell crystal meth, spiraling into a monstrous drug kingpin known as Heisenberg.

recaps.storyRecap: The apex battle between Heisenberg and Gus Fring. After Gus threatens to kill Walt's entire family, Walt strikes an unthinkable deal with Gus's mortal cartel enemy, Hector Salamanca. Hector agrees to act as a suicide bomber at Casa Tranquila nursing home. When Gus arrives to finish off Hector, Hector rings his bell, triggering the pipe bomb that rips Gus's face in half. Walter calls Skyler with three words: 'I won.'
keyMoments: Walt convinces Hector Salamanca to exact his ultimate revenge on Gus

recaps.storyRecap: Regarded as one of the greatest television episodes in history. Hank finally arrests Walt in the desert, but Uncle Jack and his neo-Nazi militia arrive despite Walt's desperate calls to call them off. A brutal shootout leaves Gomez dead and Hank executed in the sand. Jack steals $69 million of Walt's money, Jesse is taken as an enslaved meth cook, and Walt flees home only for Skyler and Walter Jr. to pull a knife on him.
